## Hypothesis

Extending the holding period from 0DTE to 1-2 day weekly options while preserving the same directional signal (ITM-2 strike, -8%/+30% exit) captures additional theta decay and reduces sensitivity to intraday noise, thereby increasing expectancy per trade without sacrificing performance on J's anchor days.

## Mechanism

The entry trigger remains identical to the base 0DTE strategy (e.g., VWAP continuation or similar structure-based signal). Upon trigger, we select the same ITM-2 strike but in the weekly expiration cycle (1 or 2 DTE) instead of 0DTE. Exit rules are unchanged: -8% stop loss, +30% profit target, and 15:50 ET time stop. Position sizing and risk parameters are adjusted per account size to maintain the same per-trade risk profile.
